_doc: Ability catalog. See docs/team/abilities.md for the schema. kind = behaviour archetype in AbilityCaster; params feed that kind; levels[] add deltas per rank (damage/cooldown are fractions, everything else adds to params; status_stacks adds to every applied status).

abilities.name: Cinder Spray
abilities.desc: Spits a fan of cinders at the nearest foe. Each cinder sets its mark Burning.

abilities.name: Inferno Nova
abilities.desc: A ring of hellfire bursts from your body, scorching and hurling back everything near.

abilities.name: Brimstone Meteor
abilities.desc: Calls burning stone down on the thickest knot of angels. The crater keeps burning.

abilities.name: Pyre Circle
abilities.desc: You walk wreathed in a circle of flame that kindles everything inside it.

abilities.name: Pillar of Gehenna
abilities.desc: Raises a column of sulphurous fire beneath a foe that burns for several seconds.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage Lance
abilities.desc: Tears 3% of your life into a piercing lance of blood. Hits leave foes Bleeding.

abilities.name: Crimson Tide
abilities.desc: Spends 5% of your life in a wave of blood. Every foe struck returns some of it to you.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.desc: Bleeds 8% of your life to enter a frenzy: +40% Might and faster casting for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Sanguine Tithe
abilities.desc: Draws blood from every angel near you. A share of it flows back into your veins.

abilities.name: Bloodboil
abilities.desc: Brands nearby foes. Their blood boils, and when they die they burst in a crimson spray.

abilities.name: Raise Thralls
abilities.desc: Drags skeletal thralls up from the ash. They hunt the nearest angel and claw at it.

abilities.name: Wraith Host
abilities.desc: Looses screaming wraiths that streak through the ranks of Heaven, passing through bodies.

abilities.name: Bone Spear
abilities.desc: Hurls a spear of fused bone that skewers a whole line of foes.

abilities.name: Corpse Detonation
abilities.desc: Detonates the fresh corpses of fallen angels around you, each a blast of bone and rot.

abilities.name: Pestilent Cloud
abilities.desc: Leaves a choking cloud of pestilence on a foe. All inside are Plagued.

abilities.name: Blight Spit
abilities.desc: Spits globs of rot. They Plague whatever they strike, and plague spreads on death.

abilities.name: Mantle of Rot
abilities.desc: A mantle of flies and decay. Foes who linger beside you sicken.

abilities.name: Locust Swarm
abilities.desc: Releases a cloud of carrion locusts that chew through the nearest angels and spread rot.

abilities.name: Infernal Storm
abilities.desc: Red lightning leaps from your claws and arcs between angels.

abilities.name: Brand of Thunder
abilities.desc: The sky over Heaven splits: crimson bolts strike random foes nearby.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.desc: Crackling orbs circle you, shocking anything they touch.

abilities.name: Tempest Crown
abilities.desc: A crown of lightning flares above you, discharging into every foe in reach.

abilities.name: Umbral Step
abilities.desc: When angels close in, you step through shadow behind the nearest one, cutting all in your path.

abilities.name: Shadow Daggers
abilities.desc: Flings a spread of black daggers. Assassin's edge: 25% chance to strike for triple damage.

abilities.name: Death Mark
abilities.desc: Marks the strongest angel nearby. After 3 seconds the mark erupts for 40 damage plus all the damage it took while marked.

abilities.name: Shade Clones
abilities.desc: Splits off shadows of yourself that dash from angel to angel, cutting as they go.

abilities.name: Brimstone Maul
abilities.desc: A crushing overhead blow in front of you. Enormous damage, slow and heavy.

abilities.name: Earthsunder
abilities.desc: Splits the ground in a long fissure toward your foe; molten rock erupts along it.

abilities.name: Hellquake
abilities.desc: Stamps the earth. A shockwave staggers and roots everything in a wide ring.

abilities.name: Hellhook
abilities.desc: Hurls barbed hooks at distant foes and drags them to your feet, Bound.

abilities.name: Binding Chains
abilities.desc: Chains erupt from the ground around foes and hold them fast.

abilities.name: Chain Whirl
abilities.desc: Spinning flails of chain sweep around you, battering anything they catch.

abilities.name: Hex of Frailty
abilities.desc: Lays a hex on nearby foes: every Curse stack makes them take 8% more damage from all sources.

abilities.name: Withering Gaze
abilities.desc: A beam of withering malice. Slows, curses and scorches everything along it.

abilities.name: Malediction
abilities.desc: Speaks an unholy word. Every foe nearby is Cursed and slowed; cursed foes that die spread it.

abilities.name: Soul Siphon
abilities.desc: Every angel slain feeds you a Soul (max 200). Fires soul bolts, one more for every 20 Souls held.

abilities.name: Reaping Wail
abilities.desc: A wail of the damned. Damage grows by 1% per Soul held. Kills feed you extra Souls.

abilities.name: Soul Lanterns
abilities.desc: Lanterns of captured souls circle you. One more lantern for every 40 Souls held.

abilities.name: Harvest of Souls
abilities.desc: Permanently: +0.2% Might per Soul held. Activates every 8s to pull all souls (XP) toward you.

abilities.name: Wrathful Cleave
abilities.desc: A furious sweep before you. +3% damage per Wrath stack (Wrath builds as you are hurt or swarmed).

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.desc: When your Wrath reaches 6 stacks, vents it as a nova: base damage plus 2.5 per Wrath stack, spending half your Wrath.

abilities.name: Berserker's Howl
abilities.desc: A howl of hate: for 5 s gain +15% Might plus 1% per Wrath stack, +1 Armor and faster casting.

abilities.name: Seething Aura
abilities.desc: Your hate scalds everything near you. +5% damage per Wrath stack.

abilities.name: Coin Barrage
abilities.desc: Flings a fan of burning coins. +0.4% damage per Ichor you carry. Kills sometimes spill Ichor.

abilities.name: Midas Touch
abilities.desc: Gilds nearby angels: they take 15% more damage and drop Ichor when they die.

abilities.name: Avarice
abilities.desc: Spends 2 Ichor to drop a molten ingot on the thickest crowd. +0.6% damage per Ichor you carry.

abilities.name: Tithe of Coins
abilities.desc: Spinning coins circle you. +0.4% damage per Ichor you carry. Kills sometimes spill Ichor.

abilities.name: Stolen Radiance
abilities.desc: Snatches holy orbs and bolts flying near you and hurls them back, twice as hard. With none to steal, fires a stolen ray.

abilities.name: Covetous Gaze
abilities.desc: Copies the nearest angel's own attack and turns it on Heaven: its volley, its charge, its slam or its smite.

abilities.name: Jealous Hex
abilities.desc: Curses nearby angels. When a hexed angel dies you steal its glory: +3% Might for 8 s (stacks).

abilities.name: Hubris
abilities.desc: Gathers pride while you go unhurt, then drops a colossal blade on the mightiest angel near: up to 4x damage. Being hit costs some of it.

abilities.name: Pride's Fall
abilities.desc: Once in a long while, a falling star of pure arrogance flattens a whole host.

abilities.name: Crown of Contempt
abilities.desc: Singles out the mightiest angel for scorn: a hit with 35% chance to crit for x3, and two Curse stacks.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.desc: Swallows a weak angel beside you whole: heals 3 HP and adds Girth (+2 max HP, a little bigger). Stronger ones just get bitten.

abilities.name: Maw of Hell
abilities.desc: A great maw bites the crowd in front of you. Each kill heals 1 HP.

abilities.name: Bilious Belch
abilities.desc: Belches a cloud of half-digested bile onto the nearest foe: Plagued and slowed.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.desc: Leaves a glass double of yourself that flings mirror shards, then shatters when crowded or after 6 s.

abilities.name: Hall of Mirrors
abilities.desc: Panes of enchanted glass circle you, dazing (slowing) whatever they cut.

abilities.name: Doppelganger
abilities.desc: Calls a succubus wearing your face. She hexes angels from range.

abilities.name: Brimstone Turret
abilities.desc: Bolts an iron turret to the ground beside you. It spits burning slugs at angels for 12 s (2 at once).

abilities.name: Hellmine Field
abilities.desc: Strews spiked mines around you. They arm in a moment and burst when an angel steps close.

abilities.name: Infernal Engine
abilities.desc: Plants a squat engine that belches cones of hellfire at anything within 6 m.

abilities.name: Hellfire Lash
abilities.desc: A long burning lash in front of you. Foes caught by the tip take 70% more.

abilities.name: Chain Dance
abilities.desc: You whirl a burning chain all the way around you, twice.

abilities.name: Barbed Flurry
abilities.desc: Four quick lashes of a barbed scourge, each tearing flesh (Bleeding).

abilities.name: Call the Pack
abilities.desc: Hellhounds bound from the pit and run down the nearest angels.

abilities.name: Imp Rabble
abilities.desc: A cackling rabble of imps pours out of the ground, biting ankles and setting them alight.

abilities.name: Pit Brute
abilities.desc: Unchains a hulking brute from the pit. Slow, but every swing hurls angels aside.

demon_affinity._doc: Each demon's favoured school: its abilities are offered weight x more often and deal +damage. Matches Progression's mastery signature boons (docs/team/progression.md).
